newsitem.title: USA: Workers at Illinois plant denied day off to vote.
newsitem.headline: Workers at Illinois plant denied day off to vote.

text.p: Maurice Taylor, who lost a long-shot try for the Republican Party's presidential nomination months ago, has now failed in an attempt to give his employees a day off for voting next Tuesday.
Taylor, president of Titan Wheel International Inc., said Wednesday he had been told by the Federal Elections Commission it was illegal to offer employees any type of incentive to vote.
Taylor had announced earlier that any Titan employee who voted in the presidential election, for the candidate of their choice, would get an extra day of vacation.

Taylor told his staff Wednesday to vote anyway. But he advised them not to support any office-holder who has been in Washington longer than six years and to vote only for people who have worked in "real jobs" and have reached the age of 55.
A political unknown who drew little support, Taylor was in the crowded field that formed more than a year ago seeking the Republican nomination eventually won by Bob Dole.
